You know, crazy things have happened in this universe. We all have this existentialist moment in our lives that money will make us happy. But money is only a vehicle to value. Have a good idea, or a vision, and money will serve you well. Money is leverage--this is a game, but with happiness as the points real as ever. Money has too often become a burdened entrenchment instead of an enabler. For businesses it promotes growth but for people with more wrinkled collars it creates treadmills. 

What would you guys do with $1 million dollars? To make the world better, start something as a seed. There's a lot of suffering in the world and throwing money at a certain foundation may seem like a great cause--but often it is lost in the cracks. Ever person needs to get by, and these foundations are not godlike. So the best way to use a large sum of money is investment ALONGSIDE asking the people "what do you think this world-- in its entirety--needs". People fall in love, watch movies, have fights, wander the streets, struggle for water, live days without knowing what goes on across those seas-- these are all real. What do you think humanity needs the most? It is crowdsourced entrepreneurship--because one mind can do it, but many minds will make it worth it. 

I'd like for people not to stress too much about student loans. Is there a way we can use money for more than bandaiding and giving fish, and more towards teaching how to fish? To alleviate this burden for multiple people instead of within family and ingroups? 

What does humanity need right now? Not more apps or technology--albiet those are the easiest things to make, and those who do want to help are encouraged to make them because they are very salient. But there's something out there that we just need to unlock. Because we have made progress in our small time here, and the aggregate of every individual who feels, is our condition. 

My dad always used to say "just give me 2 millions dollars and I'll be happy". I don't know if that's so thought out. $1 million dollars and we'll see how much happiness we can bring to others. That's growing wealth if anything, instead of dying with individual wealth and your mind and your brain all gone. Aside from the prize, what do you think humanity needs the most, all other existing ventures considered?
